note: The raw fuzz input bytes are copied into the packet lexer input buffer and the input length is retained.
The initialized lexer is passed to the packet parser with inbufptr at inbuffer and inbuflen equal to the fuzz input size.
Leading bytes remain in the lexer input buffer; the later 0xd3 byte selects the RTCM3 packet recognizer.
The next two input bytes are interpreted as the RTCM3 payload length field.
The recognizer adds only the three checksum bytes to the declared payload length, so a zero-length RTCM3 frame is considered complete after three bytes following the header.
The parser reaches RTCM3_RECOGNIZED when the decremented counter reaches zero.
Final validation scans the retained input buffer to find the RTCM3 preamble offset before recomputing the length.
On checksum failure, the diagnostic indexes from inbufptr using the preamble offset idx, which can point past the stack lexer object when the frame is not aligned at inbuffer[0].
